answer_1.quote: We propose the framework ABSINSTRUCT to build instructions with detailed explanation traces and well-crafted data selection, as shown in Figure . The framework forms explanation traces by collecting meanings of each given instance and abstract concept. These traces can help LLMs better comprehend the underlying reasoning process of detecting abstract concepts.
answer_1.outputs: The model generates explanation traces and binary predictions (Yes/No) for whether an abstract concept is a valid generalization of an instance within a given context.

answer_2.quote: We calculate Accuracy and Macro F1-score for metrics between predicted and ground truth labels to evaluate all models' abstraction ability.

answer_4.quote: Human evaluations are performed by three expert annotators with at least one year of expertise in NLP to ensure quality.
answer_4.guideline: The expert annotators are asked to annotate which response is preferred between our framework and the Alapca baseline.
